name: mac4dstem
description: Lets Claude look at what mac4DSTEM's windows show on this Mac: result maps, patterns, detected disks, objects and the log. Read-only.
long_description: mac4DSTEM is the MCP server itself, on this Mac only (127.0.0.1). This extension carries Claude's requests to it. In mac4DSTEM, turn on Settings > Agents, press Copy Connection Command and paste the copied line below. The extension talks to no other computer.

connection.title: Connection command
connection.description: In mac4DSTEM: Settings > Agents > Copy Connection Command, then paste it here.
